zh.title: 台灣海軍編列預算籌購32架銳鳶二與280架V-BAT無人機
zh.summary: 台灣海軍編預算籌購32架銳鳶二與280架V-BAT無人機；提升遠海偵蒐
body: 國防部於2026年8月31日上午將116年度國防預算書送抵立法院。根據預算書內容，中華民國海軍將籌購32架國造銳鳶二型無人機，以及280架外購的艦載V-BAT垂直起降無人機。這兩項無人機籌購案於去年原編列於機密預算中，今年度則轉列為公開預算，旨在充實海軍戰場監偵與監控能量。
在國造銳鳶二型無人機（第二代海搜戰術型無人機監偵系統）方面，海軍編列115年至118年（2026年至2029年）的持續預算共計新台幣167億8974萬元，預計籌購32架無人機、8套導控站及48輛運輸載具。該型無人機由國家中山科學研究院研製，採用多功掛載構型，可依任務需求攜帶浮標莢艙或勁蜂一型攻擊無人機，具有16小時的滯空時間與超過300公里的導控距離。
在大宗外購無人機方面，海軍規劃於115年至118年編列360億元持續預算，採購280架艦載智慧垂直起降型V-BAT無人機、140套導控系統及82輛運輸載具。V-BAT無人機由美國國防科技廠商Shield AI研發生產，採用單發動機導管風扇設計，具備在艦載甲板與狹窄空間垂直起降並切換至水平巡航的能力，且能抗GPS與電磁干擾，在複雜電磁環境下執行獨立偵察與目標標定任務。
海軍說明指出，引進這兩款無人機旨在提升遠海戰場透明度、強化海域覺知與擊殺鏈時效，防止作戰初期指管系統遭癱瘓。此外，海軍亦新編約237億元預算，規劃於116年至122年建造12艘水下無人載具，以強化水下偵察與獵雷作業效能，全案已於今年8月7日獲核定並於明年度辦理先期規劃設計。

en.title: Taiwan Navy Budgets for 32 Albatross II and 280 V-BAT Drones
en.summary: Taiwan Navy plans to acquire 32 Albatross II and 280 V-BAT drones under multi-year budget proposals.
body: The Republic of China Navy has allocated funding to procure 32 indigenous Albatross II unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and 280 foreign-sourced V-BAT vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) UAVs, according to defense budget documentation submitted to the Legislative Yuan on August 31, 2026. The procurement programs, previously classified under confidential budget items in the prior fiscal year, have now been declassified in the public defense budget.

For the Albatross II program, designated as the second-generation maritime tactical UAV surveillance system, the Navy has budgeted NT$16.789 billion (approximately US$525 million) spanning fiscal years 2026 through 2029. The procurement package covers 32 UAV airframes, 8 ground control stations, and 48 transport vehicles. Developed by the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology (NCSIST), the Albatross II features a multi-payload capacity capable of deploying sonar buoys or Chien Hsiang attack drones, boasting an endurance of 16 hours and a control range exceeding 300 kilometers.

Simultaneously, the Navy has budgeted NT$36 billion over the same four-year period from fiscal 2026 to 2029 to acquire 280 shipborne V-BAT VTOL UAVs, 140 control systems, and 82 transport vehicles. Designed and manufactured by U.S. defense technology firm Shield AI, the V-BAT employs a single-engine ducted-fan configuration allowing vertical takeoff and landing on ship decks or confined spaces before transitioning to horizontal cruise. It is engineered to operate autonomously in environments where GPS or communications signals are heavily jammed.

The Navy stated that acquiring these tactical unmanned aerial assets will enhance deep-sea battlefield transparency, improve maritime search and target identification, and reinforce command-and-control resilience during initial operational phases. In addition to the aerial systems, the Navy has separately budgeted approximately NT$23.7 billion between fiscal 2027 and 2033 to construct 12 underwater unmanned vehicles, with preliminary design work scheduled to begin next year.

zh.title: 奧地利AXIS進軍直升機模擬器市場 首批支援空中巴士與李奧納多平台
zh.summary: 奧地利AXIS進軍直升機模擬器市場；預計20個月內推出首台訓練設備。
body: 奧地利模擬器製造商AXIS Flight Simulation宣布進軍直升機模擬器市場，規劃推出兩款新型訓練設備，包括高真度AX-DH模擬器與固定式飛行訓練設備（FTD），以滿足民用與專業旋翼機營運商日益增長的訓練需求。
該公司表示，兩款設備將採用通用基礎架構與可互換式駕駛艙，首波規劃支援空中巴士直升機（Airbus Helicopters）與李奧納多（Leonardo）機型平台。AXIS預計首台直升機訓練設備將在大約20個月內問世。
AXIS執行董事會成員克里斯蒂安·托爾曼（Christian Theuermann）指出，此次業務擴展主要源於客戶的主動需求。新設備將支援緊急醫療服務、搜救、離岸作業及夜視鏡飛行等任務的個人與多機組訓練。

en.title: AXIS Flight Simulation Enters Helicopter Market with Airbus and Leonardo Types
en.summary: AXIS Flight Simulation enters helicopter training market with new devices; first availability targeted within 20 months.
body: Austrian manufacturer AXIS Flight Simulation is entering the rotary-wing market with two new training devices, responding to demand from civil and specialist helicopter operators. The company is developing the high-fidelity AX-DH simulator alongside a fixed-base Flight Training Device designed for regulatory approval.

Both devices will feature interchangeable cockpits built on a common architecture. AXIS plans to offer Airbus Helicopters and Leonardo platforms first, expecting its initial helicopter simulator or training device to become available within approximately 20 months.

Christian Theuermann, an executive board member at AXIS, stated that the expansion was driven by customers seeking rotary-wing simulation products. The new devices are intended to support single and multi-crew training for missions such as emergency medical services, search and rescue, offshore operations, and night-vision flight.

zh.title: 薩博雙座Gripen F戰機完成首飛　展開巴西空軍測飛計畫
zh.summary: 薩博雙座Gripen F於瑞典首飛；展開巴西空軍飛試與系統評估
body: 瑞典國防製造商薩博（Saab）於瑞典林雪平（Linköping）機場完成雙座戰鬥機Gripen F的首飛，該機在當地時間上午09:40起飛，飛行時間共計40分鐘。此次首飛標誌著這款最新世代雙座戰機正式進入空中測試階段，後續將準備交付予啟動客戶巴西空軍（Brazilian Air Force）。
首飛試飛任務由薩博首席試飛員雅各布·霍格伯格（Jakob Högberg）與巴西空軍試飛員阿布敦·德·雷森德·瓦斯康塞洛斯空軍中校（Lieutenant Colonel Aviator Abdon de Rezende Vasconcelos）共同執行。飛行過程驗證了機載核心系統的運作，並對戰機的飛行性能進行了初步評估。
Gripen F是以單座型Gripen E戰機為基礎開發的雙座構型，額外提供第二名機組人員的乘坐空間。該機型的主要作用在於加速飛行員的轉換訓練，且同時具備執行先進作戰任務的能力。在複雜的作戰任務中，雙人機組人員的分工合作有助於提升整體操作效率。
隨著首飛完成，Gripen F進入飛行測試階段，測試計畫將由薩博位於瑞典的飛行測試中心負責執行。測試項目包含生產接收飛行，並逐步擴展戰機的速度、高度、G值過載與攻角等飛行包線，同時評估戰機的戰術能力與後座專屬功能。
巴西作為Gripen F計畫的啟動客戶，深度參與了該戰機的開發過程。這項合作源於巴西與瑞典之間的戰略夥伴關係及技術轉移計畫，超過350名巴西工程師、技術人員與飛行員參與了相關的開發、生產、飛試與維修培訓。薩博目前尚未提供首架戰機的確切交付日期。

en.title: Saab Completes First Flight of Two-Seat Gripen F Fighter for Brazil
en.summary: Saab completes maiden flight of Gripen F in Sweden; begins flight tests for Brazilian Air Force.
body: Swedish defense manufacturer Saab has completed the maiden flight of the Gripen F, placing the two-seat version of its latest-generation fighter into airborne testing ahead of delivery to the Brazilian Air Force. The aircraft took off from Saab's airfield in Linköping, Sweden, at 09:40 local time and remained airborne for a total flight duration of 40 minutes.

The inaugural flight was crewed by Saab chief test pilot Jakob Högberg alongside Brazilian Air Force test pilot Lieutenant Colonel Aviator Abdon de Rezende Vasconcelos. The sortie successfully verified the operation of the fighter's core onboard systems and provided an initial evaluation of its baseline flight performance characteristics.

Based on the single-seat Gripen E, the two-seat Gripen F retains full operational combat capabilities while accommodating a second crew member. The aircraft is designed to accelerate pilot conversion training without removing its operational mission capacity, while also supporting complex missions where distributing workload across two crew members provides an operational advantage.

The initial flight marks the start of a comprehensive airborne test campaign conducted by Saab's Flight Test Center in Sweden. The test program will begin with production acceptance sorties before progressively expanding the aircraft's operational flight envelope across speed, altitude, G-load, and angle of attack, alongside evaluating tactical systems and rear-cockpit functionality.

Brazil is the launch customer for the Gripen F and an active participant in its joint development under a strategic technology-transfer agreement with Sweden. More than 350 Brazilian engineers, technicians, and pilots have completed training in development, production, flight testing, and maintenance. Saab has not yet specified an official delivery date for the first Gripen F.

zh.title: 捷克Zuri發表油電混合垂直起降無人貨機原型機
zh.summary: 捷克Zuri發表油電混合無人貨機原型機，預計2027年初進行首飛測試。
body: 捷克航空企業Zuri於2026年8月27日正式發表新款無人油電混合垂直起降（VTOL）傾轉旋翼貨機驗證機。該型航空器基於先前的「技術驗證機2.0」（Technology Demonstrator 2.0）架構開發，定位為同時具備民用與國防雙重用途的雙用平台，旨在為該公司提供更快速的商業收益轉化途徑。
根據Zuri公佈的技術參數，該機最大有效載重為165公斤，巡航速度達到每小時220公里。在載重超過100公斤的情況下，不保留餘油航程可達679公里以上；若保留30分鐘備用油量，航程則為569公里。該型無人機具備良好的場地適應能力，可在船艦甲板、開闊地面或直升機起降場進行起降作業，主要目標市場包括北海油氣平台、離島及波羅的海區域的貨物運補。
動力系統方面，該機採用內燃機帶動發電機產生飛行所需電能，可使用航空汽油（AVGAS）、一般汽油或生物乙醇燃料，並搭配電池組作為備用電力系統。全機配備8組分散式推進旋翼，當單一旋翼發生故障時仍可保持操控，發電機若失效亦能由電池供電降落。此外，Zuri強調該產品符合無國際武器貿易條例（ITAR-free）規範，並採用歐洲本土供應鏈打造。
目前該型驗證機已在布拉格進行系統整合與地面測試，計畫於2027年初開展首飛測試，並預計在2027年至2029年間交付首批商業客戶。Zuri創辦人兼執行長Michal Illich表示，該機飛行過程仍由地面操作員遠端遙控，目前本階段資金將用於支持全尺寸驗證機及其完整飛行測試計畫。

en.title: Czech firm Zuri unveils hybrid-electric cargo VTOL tiltrotor drone demonstrator
en.summary: Czech company Zuri unveiled a hybrid-electric cargo VTOL drone demonstrator, with flight tests planned for early 2027.
body: Czech aerospace startup Zuri unveiled its new uncrewed hybrid-electric cargo VTOL tiltrotor demonstrator on August 27, 2026. Built upon the company's earlier Technology Demonstrator 2.0 architecture, the aircraft is designed for both civil and defense operations. Zuri stated that developing this uncrewed cargo platform serves as a faster path to generating revenue as part of its longer-term vision to build a six-seater passenger aircraft.

According to Zuri, the tiltrotor aircraft features a useful load of 165 kg and operates at a cruising speed of 220 km/h. When carrying a payload of over 100 kg, it achieves a flight range exceeding 679 km without fuel reserves, or 569 km with a 30-minute reserve allowance. The drone is engineered to operate from various locations, including ship decks, open ground, and landing pads, with target applications in offshore oil platform supply, island logistics, and regional cargo transport.

The aircraft's hybrid propulsion system utilizes an internal combustion engine driving a generator to produce in-flight electricity, capable of running on AVGAS, petrol, or bioethanol, complemented by a backup battery system. Featuring eight distributed rotors, the design maintains flight control in the event of a single rotor failure, while the battery permits a safe landing if the generator fails. Zuri highlighted that the platform is ITAR-free and manufactured using a sovereign European supply chain.

The full-scale demonstrator is currently undergoing systems integration and ground testing in Prague. Flight tests are scheduled to begin in early 2027, with initial commercial deliveries expected between 2027 and 2029. Zuri founder and CEO Michal Illich noted that the aircraft will be remotely piloted by a ground operator, and the current funding round supports the completion of the demonstrator and its flight test campaign.

zh.title: FAA指令檢查波音787機翼結構 涵蓋全球77架客機
zh.summary: FAA要求檢查部分波音787機翼結構；涵蓋全球77架客機；波音稱營運維持正常
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）發布適航指令AD 2026-17-02，要求對部分波音787-8、787-9與787-10客機進行機翼結構檢查，以防範潛在的金屬疲勞裂紋風險。該指令於8月27日在《聯邦公報》發布，並將於10月1日正式生效，涵蓋美國17架及全球77架民航機。
監管單位指出，此項問題源自波音公司於2019年調查發現生產過程採用過時方法測量機身接合板墊片。波音對此回應表示，相關製造問題已在後續生產中獲得修正，全球機隊受影響飛機目前均可繼續保持正常營運。

en.title: FAA Orders Boeing 787 Wing Inspections Over Potential Fatigue Cracks
en.summary: FAA orders inspections for 77 Boeing 787 aircraft globally; Boeing states normal operations continue.
body: The US Federal Aviation Administration has issued Airworthiness Directive AD 2026-17-02, requiring inspections of certain Boeing 787-8, 787-9, and 787-10 aircraft due to potential fatigue cracks in critical wing structures. Published in the Federal Register on August 27, the directive takes effect on October 1 and affects 17 US-registered airplanes and 77 worldwide out of a global fleet exceeding 1,100 Boeing 787s.

The inspection requirement follows a 2019 discovery that an outdated method was used to measure shims at lower side-of-body splice plates during production. Boeing stated that the manufacturing issue has since been corrected in production and that affected aircraft may continue normal operations.

zh.title: 紐西蘭航空年度稅前虧損3.36億紐元 燃油與引擎問題侵蝕獲利
zh.summary: 紐西蘭航空公布年度稅前虧損3.36億紐元；燃油價格上漲與引擎故障大幅侵蝕獲利。
body: 紐西蘭航空（Air New Zealand）公布截至6月30日止的財政年度業績，錄得稅前虧損3.36億紐元（約合1.999億美元），與上一年度錄得稅前利潤1.64億紐元（約合9760萬美元）相比出現轉折。航空公司的稅後淨虧損為2.42億紐元（約合1.44億美元），上一年度經重述的稅後淨利潤則為1.08億紐元（約合6430萬美元）。
儘管年度業績整體呈虧損狀態，紐西蘭航空的營收仍有所成長。總收入增加至約70億紐元（約合41.7億美元），其中客運收入增至61億紐元（約合36.3億美元）。然而，營運成本增加的速度明顯超越獲利能力，主因受到燃料價格飆升、飛機引擎可用性限制以及維修費用上漲等多重因素影響。
地緣政治衝突推升全球能源價格，成為航空公司重大意外支出。紐西蘭航空預估中東地區衝突使其下半年的燃料成本較原先預期增加3.28億紐元。在計入燃料對衝營運後，額外成本約為2.05億紐元（約合1.22億美元）。紐西蘭航空雖然透過調整機票價格及減少運力進行因應，但燃料價格上漲仍使其稅前業績減少約1.35億紐元（約合8030萬美元）。

機隊可用性問題亦嚴重衝擊財務表現。紐西蘭航空指出，旗下窄體空中巴士（Airbus）A321neo機隊採用的普惠（Pratt & Whitney）GTF引擎，以及長程波音（Boeing）787機隊採用的勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）Trent 1000引擎均面臨可靠性問題。公司估計引擎可用性問題在最新財政年度造成約1.90億紐元的損失，影響包含運力損失、租賃費用、飛機利用率降低及營運效率下降。此外，不含匯率影響的維修成本較2025年增加了約1.39億紐元（約合8270萬美元）。

en.title: Air New Zealand Posts $199.9M Pre-Tax Loss Driven by Fuel and Engine Costs
en.summary: Air New Zealand reports NZ$336 million annual pre-tax loss; surging fuel prices and engine issues hit earnings.
body: Air New Zealand has reported a pre-tax loss of NZ$336 million ($199.9 million) for the financial year ended June 30, reversing a pre-tax profit of NZ$164 million ($97.6 million) recorded in the previous year. The carrier's net loss after tax reached NZ$242 million ($144.0 million), compared with a restated net profit of NZ$108 million ($64.3 million) in the prior fiscal period.

Despite the overall financial loss, the airline experienced growth in passenger demand and top-line earnings. Air New Zealand's total revenue increased to approximately NZ$7 billion ($4.17 billion), while passenger revenue rose to NZ$6.1 billion ($3.63 billion). However, escalating operational expenses expanded significantly faster than revenue generation throughout the twelve-month reporting period.

Surging jet fuel prices represented one of the largest unexpected expenditures for the carrier. Air New Zealand estimated that geopolitical conflict in the Middle East raised its second-half fuel expense by NZ$328 million compared to expectations. After factoring in fuel hedging strategies, the net additional fuel cost stood at around NZ$205 million ($122 million). Despite adjusting ticket prices and reducing capacity, the airline estimated that higher fuel prices reduced its pre-tax result by approximately NZ$135 million ($80.3 million).

Fleet availability challenges further impacted performance as the airline dealt with engine reliability problems. The issues affected Pratt & Whitney Geared Turbofan (GTF) engines fitted on its narrowbody Airbus A321neo fleet and Rolls-Royce Trent 1000 engines powering its long-haul Boeing 787 aircraft. Air New Zealand estimated that these engine availability issues cost the carrier approximately NZ$190 million ($80.3 million) during the financial year, resulting from lost capacity, replacement lease costs, lower aircraft utilization, and operational inefficiencies.

Operational cost pressures were compounded by higher maintenance spending across the fleet. Maintenance expenses increased by around NZ$139 million ($82.7 million) compared with 2025, excluding foreign exchange effects, driven by lifecycle maintenance requirements. Nevertheless, Air New Zealand indicated that more aircraft are returning to active service, with fleet reliability expected to improve as the year progresses.
